player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" while in the Game room, failing to explore the available "north" direction which likely led to an unvisited room. My mistake was assuming the exploration was complete after returning to a previously visited room without checking all available exits. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms and only issue "DONE" when I am in a room where all available directions lead to rooms I have already visited. Specifically, upon returning to the Game room, I must take the "north" direction before considering the task finished.
